verdict.rationale: Fathom is a meeting recorder and transcription product, so attributing transcript words to named speakers is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents transcripts and transcript endpoints (e.g., unlimited transcriptions, a get-transcript API, transcript delivery via webhook). None of it describes speaker diarization or matching speakers to real participant names, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"
